mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_operations_risk_event WHERE is_delete = 0 AND event_status IN (0, 1)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_service_ticket WHERE is_delete = 0 AND ticket_status NOT IN (5, 6, 7)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_withdrawal WHERE is_delete = 0 AND withdrawal_status = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0.00) FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_withdrawal WHERE is_delete = 0 AND withdrawal_status = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application WHERE is_delete = 0 AND application_status IN (0, 2)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_market_report WHERE is_delete = 0 AND report_status = 0

SELECT risk_event_id AS task_id, 1 AS task_type, CASE WHEN risk_level >= 3 THEN 3 WHEN risk_level = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS priority, event_status AS task_status, subject, detail, CAST(risk_event_id AS CHAR) AS business_no, '平台' AS merchant_name, DATE_FORMAT(first_seen_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(last_seen_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_operations_risk_event WHERE is_delete = 0 AND event_status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY priority DESC, last_seen_time DESC, risk_event_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.ticket_id AS task_id, 2 AS task_type, t.priority, CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS task_status, t.ticket_title AS subject, t.ticket_content AS detail, t.ticket_no AS business_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), NULLIF(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code, '平台工单') AS merchant_name, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(t.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_service_ticket t LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member m ON m.member_id = t.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0 WHERE t.is_delete = 0 AND t.ticket_status NOT IN (5, 6, 7) ORDER BY t.priority DESC, t.create_time ASC, t.ticket_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.withdrawal_id AS task_id, 3 AS task_type, 2 AS priority, 0 AS task_status, '提现审核' AS subject, CONCAT('商户申请提现 ', FORMAT(w.amount, 2), ' 元，渠道：', CASE WHEN UPPER(w.withdrawal_channel) = 'ALIPAY' THEN '支付宝' WHEN UPPER(w.withdrawal_channel) = 'BANK_TRANSFER' THEN '银行转账' ELSE '其他渠道' END) AS detail, w.withdrawal_no AS business_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), NULLIF(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code) AS merchant_name, DATE_FORMAT(w.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(w.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_withdrawal w LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member m ON m.member_id = w.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0 WHERE w.is_delete = 0 AND w.withdrawal_status = 0 ORDER BY w.create_time ASC, w.withdrawal_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.invoice_application_id AS task_id, 4 AS task_type, 2 AS priority, a.application_status AS task_status, CASE WHEN a.application_status = 0 THEN '发票申请审核' ELSE '发票开具' END AS subject, CONCAT('申请编号：', a.application_no, '，金额：', FORMAT(a.amount, 2), ' 元') AS detail, a.application_no AS business_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), NULLIF(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code, '未知商户') AS merchant_name, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application a LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member m ON m.member_id = a.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.is_delete = 0 AND a.application_status IN (0, 2) ORDER BY a.application_status ASC, a.create_time ASC, a.invoice_application_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.report_id AS task_id, 5 AS task_type, 3 AS priority, r.report_status AS task_status, CONCAT('市场举报：', COALESCE(p.post_no, '未知帖子')) AS subject, CONCAT('举报类型：', COALESCE(NULLIF(r.report_type, ''), '其他')) AS detail, p.post_no AS business_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(reported.nickname, ''), NULLIF(reported.legal_subject_name, ''), reported.member_code, '未知商户') AS merchant_name, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_market_report r LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post p ON p.post_id = r.post_id AND p.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member reported ON reported.member_id = r.reported_member_id AND reported.is_delete = 0 WHERE r.is_delete = 0 AND r.report_status = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time ASC, r.report_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
